fused_topology.title: Financial Data Ingestion Network
fused_topology.description: A network designed for ingesting financial data feeds and processing them in dedicated market data pods before distributing to three campus sites.
fused_topology.topology_summary: The network includes dedicated pods for data ingestion and processing, with each pod containing feed handlers, analytics workloads, and execution engines. The processed data is then distributed to three campus sites, each equipped with a switch and connected via trunk links for inter-site communication.
